payload.title: Flaky: mobile chat bar renders 660px wide in the ts browser acceptance job
payload.description: features/newsroom-mobile-chat.feature scenarios 'Open and close chat across phone sizes and orientation' (line 10) and 'Use chat with a reduced keyboard viewport' (line 20) fail intermittently in the ts job (Shared chat browser acceptance): AssertionError {x:66.5,y:856,width:660,height:44}, the chat bar is 660px wide and does not fit the phone viewport. Seen on Papyrus develop push run 42545576859 (2026-11-09 01:31 UTC) and once on PR #1310 (passed on rerun). Not caused by those changes (Python-only). Needs a deterministic fix in scripts/private-chat-ui-fixture.mjs / the chat bar layout.
